content: RAṂ YAṂ KHAṂ. Contemplating the excellent offerings as untainted, great clouds of nectar and sensory enjoyments, I multiply them extensively with OṂ ĀḤ HŪṂ.KYE! This perfect incense offering—To the Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha,To the Guru, Yidam, and Ḍākinī,To the Dharma protectors, wealth deities, treasure guardians, and the rest,You who guard and protect me,Please accept this vast incense offering,And act as a companion to make my wind-horse flourish.KYE! The deity dwelling in the central direction,The protective deity of the flourishing wind-horse,The supreme king of horses, Bālāha,I offer incense to the swift and powerful protective deity;Make my wind-horse flourish,And please restore my wind-horse when it has declined.KYE! The deity dwelling in the eastern direction,The protective deity of the flourishing wind-horse,With a turquoise mane like a white lion,I offer incense to the heroic and powerful protective deity;Make my wind-horse flourish,And please restore my wind-horse when it has declined.KYE! The deity dwelling in the southern direction,The protective deity of the flourishing wind-horse,With a copper crest like a turquoise dragon,I offer incense to the fierce-voiced protective deity;Make my wind-horse flourish,And please restore my wind-horse when it has declined.KYE! The deity dwelling in the western direction,The protective deity of the flourishing wind-horse,With the spots of a royal tiger,I offer incense to the heroic and fierce protective deity;Make my wind-horse flourish,And please restore my wind-horse when it has declined.KYE! The deity dwelling in the northern direction,The protective deity of the flourishing wind-horse,With a topknot of a great garuḍa jewel,I offer incense to the powerful protective deity;Make my wind-horse flourish,And please restore my wind-horse when it has declined.KYE! The deities dwelling in the four directions and intermediate points,I offer incense to the deities of the five elements;Make the wind-horse of the elements flourish,And please restore my wind-horse when it has declined.I offer incense to the deities of the eight trigrams;Make the wind-horse of the trigrams flourish,And please restore my wind-horse when it has declined.I offer incense to the deities of the nine magic squares;Make the wind-horse of the magic squares flourish,And please restore my wind-horse when it has declined.I offer incense to the deities of the years, months, days, and times;Make the wind-horse of the years and months flourish,And please restore my wind-horse when it has declined.I offer incense to the guiding deities and the protecting deities,To the male deities, female deities, and ancestral deities,To the shoulder deities and the body deities—all of them.Make my wind-horse flourish,And please restore my wind-horse when it has declined.Generate it! Raise the wind-horse upward,Generate the radiance and prowess in my body,Generate the power and efficacy of truth in my speech,Generate the meditative absorption of bliss in my mind,And please pacify all illnesses, harmful spirits, and obstacles.May my lifespan, merit, power, and wealth increase and flourish,Subdue the world of appearances, liberate enemies and obstructors,Raise high the victory banner that triumphs in all directions,And please accomplish all the purposes I desire.Victory! Victory! May the deities be victorious!May we be victorious in the presence of the gods!Bring the demonic forces of the dark side to submission,And please accomplish the enlightened activities entrusted to you.Oṃ sarva bhijaya samaya ghijaya padhi pitri khyiu sarva du du hoḥ.If this mantra of the four-fold Wind Horse is written in precious ink or black ink and worn on the body, the lifespan and splendor of body, speech, and mind will increase; if one is a monastic, one’s qualities will flourish; if one is a layperson, one’s aspirations will be fulfilled, and one will be supremely victorious over lifespan and enemies; this has come from the treasure of the great vidyādhara Rol-pa'i-rdo-rje; treasure seal; virtue.
